1+ year of relevant experience in software technical support, systems administration, application configuration, or a similar operational technical role (equivalent experience may be considered in place of formal education).

Demonstrated ability to investigate basic-to-moderately complex system issues, isolate root causes using logs or diagnostic tools, and determine when to resolve independently versus escalate.
Solid written communication, organizational, and documentation skills, with the ability to explain technical findings and configuration status clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Hands-on experience working with issue-tracking/ticketing systems (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow) and technical troubleshooting workflows.
Familiarity with application configuration frameworks, REST APIs, log inspection tools, or SQL/data querying for validation and testing.

Experience working in fintech, financial services, or regulated operational environments.
Track record of creating technical documentation, runbooks, or template improvements that streamline team workflows.
